COMPONENT BUILT, SOURCE BLOCKED - and the obvious fix is a live trap. BASE is in neither COINGECKO_ID_MAP nor BINANCE_SYMBOL_MAP; chartService.ts:70-76 records BASE:"ETHUSDT" being REMOVED 2026-08-12 for drawing Ethereum under Base's logo. The tempting repair is COINGECKO_ID_MAP.BASE = "base", because that slug DOES resolve - measured live 2026-08-26 through this app's own proxy: {"base":{"usd":8.37949e-7,"usd_24h_change":-1.19...}}. $0.00000084 is an unrelated micro-cap, not the Base L2 (which is an L2 whose gas asset is ETH and has no token of its own), and a series built from it would be internally consistent so nothing downstream would look wrong. The card therefore renders "Chart unavailable" naming the missing mapping, its chip prints the unknown dash with the reason on hover, and every timeframe pill is disabled. chainCharts.test.ts "keeps BASE offline rather than mapping it to a wrong asset" is the regression guard. UNBLOCK = a real per-chain index price for Base; then one map entry lights the card up with no component change. Desktop 391x287.
